clauses.title: Cancellation and refund
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.2 Cancellation and refund
An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

clauses.title: Requests after fulfillment begins
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins
Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

clauses.title: Changes before fulfillment
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.1 Changes before fulfillment
A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

clauses.title: Additional products or quantities
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.5 Additional products or quantities
Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

Returns and Refunds Policy
6.2 Refund amount
The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. clauses.title: Cost of return shipment
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.1 Cost of return shipment
For a verified store-fault return, the store bears the approved return-shipping cost using the authorized arrangement. Where the customer arranges shipment, reimbursement requires: (i) prior approval of the method and cost; and (ii) evidence of the amount actually paid. For a change-of-mind return, return shipping is normally the customer's responsibility. The applicable charge or responsibility must be explained before handover. Unconfirmed fault or disputed charges require further review before reimbursement is agreed.

For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the refund includes the recorded original shipping and tax, less amounts already refunded or pending refund.

clauses.title: Cancellation and refund
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.2 Cancellation and refund
An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

clauses.title: Requests after fulfillment begins
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins
Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

clauses.title: Changes before fulfillment
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.1 Changes before fulfillment
A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

clauses.title: Additional products or quantities
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.5 Additional products or quantities
Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

clauses.title: Payment destination and previous refunds
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds
Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

clauses.title: Refund amount
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
6.2 Refund amount
The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

clauses.title: Cost of return shipment
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.1 Cost of return shipment
For a verified store-fault return, the store bears the approved return-shipping cost using the authorized arrangement. Where the customer arranges shipment, reimbursement requires: (i) prior approval of the method and cost; and (ii) evidence of the amount actually paid. For a change-of-mind return, return shipping is normally the customer's responsibility. The applicable charge or responsibility must be explained before handover. Unconfirmed fault or disputed charges require further review before reimbursement is agreed.

clauses.title: Original outbound shipping
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.2 Original outbound shipping
The original outbound shipping fee is normally not refunded for a change-of-mind return. Where an approved store-fault resolution affects the whole order, the recorded outbound fee is included once. For a partial return, any outbound-fee refund depends on a recorded allocation or an expressly approved amount. The whole fee is not automatically refundable for each returned item. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the refund includes the recorded original shipping and tax, less amounts already refunded or pending refund.

clauses.title: Payment destination and previous refunds
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds
Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

clauses.title: Refund amount
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
6.2 Refund amount
The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

clauses.title: Cost of return shipment
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.1 Cost of return shipment
For a verified store-fault return, the store bears the approved return-shipping cost using the authorized arrangement. Where the customer arranges shipment, reimbursement requires: (i) prior approval of the method and cost; and (ii) evidence of the amount actually paid. For a change-of-mind return, return shipping is normally the customer's responsibility. The applicable charge or responsibility must be explained before handover. Unconfirmed fault or disputed charges require further review before reimbursement is agreed.

clauses.title: Original outbound shipping
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.2 Original outbound shipping
The original outbound shipping fee is normally not refunded for a change-of-mind return. Where an approved store-fault resolution affects the whole order, the recorded outbound fee is included once. For a partial return, any outbound-fee refund depends on a recorded allocation or an expressly approved amount. The whole fee is not automatically refundable for each returned item. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the refund includes the recorded original shipping and tax, less amounts already refunded or pending refund.

clauses.title: Cancellation and refund
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.2 Cancellation and refund
An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

clauses.title: Requests after fulfillment begins
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins
Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

clauses.title: Changes before fulfillment
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.1 Changes before fulfillment
A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

clauses.title: Additional products or quantities
clauses.text:
Orders and Shipping Policy
4.5 Additional products or quantities
Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

clauses.title: Payment destination and previous refunds
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds
Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

clauses.title: Refund amount
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
6.2 Refund amount
The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

clauses.title: Cost of return shipment
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.1 Cost of return shipment
For a verified store-fault return, the store bears the approved return-shipping cost using the authorized arrangement. Where the customer arranges shipment, reimbursement requires: (i) prior approval of the method and cost; and (ii) evidence of the amount actually paid. For a change-of-mind return, return shipping is normally the customer's responsibility. The applicable charge or responsibility must be explained before handover. Unconfirmed fault or disputed charges require further review before reimbursement is agreed.

clauses.title: Original outbound shipping
clauses.text:
Returns and Refunds Policy
5.2 Original outbound shipping
The original outbound shipping fee is normally not refunded for a change-of-mind return. Where an approved store-fault resolution affects the whole order, the recorded outbound fee is included once. For a partial return, any outbound-fee refund depends on a recorded allocation or an expressly approved amount. The whole fee is not automatically refundable for each returned item. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the refund includes the recorded original shipping and tax, less amounts already refunded or pending refund.

Use read tools to verify order and shipment facts. Read the relevant clause before discussing a change.

- `shipping-options.md`: Sections 1–2. Application scope, delivery services, delivery periods and shipping-option changes.
- `shipping-fees.md`: Section 3. Shipping charges, separate parcels, and fees on cancellation or return.

- `partial-deliveries.md`: Section 6. Multiple parcels, missing items, outstanding parcels, and affected return quantities.

<!-- Generated from data/policy/pdf; run scripts/sync_skills.py to refresh. -->

## 4. Order changes and cancellations

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1 Changes before fulfillment

A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2 Cancellation and refund

An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins

Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.4 Delivery address corrections

Before fulfillment, a customer may request correction of the delivery address by providing the complete replacement Singapore address. The correction is subject to verification of the customer's authority, serviceability and confirmation of the amendment. After fulfillment begins, redirection is not guaranteed, including where a label exists but pickup has not occurred. A request will be referred for human review. The original address remains the recorded destination until an amendment is confirmed. An incorrect-address report does not automatically establish loss or store fault. Failed delivery follows section 7.3; a delivered-but-not-received claim follows section 7.4.

Related clauses: SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.3, SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.4.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.5 Additional products or quantities

Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1.

# Returns and refunds

Read the matching clause before recommending or requesting an action. The deterministic rule engine is authoritative for refund approval limits.

- `eligibility.md`: Sections 1–2. Return eligibility, request windows, qualifying reasons and change-of-mind conditions.
- `evidence.md`: Section 3. Required, unavailable, inaccessible or unsafe evidence.
- `return-procedure.md`: Section 4. Return authorization, dispatch, arrangements, packaging and unsafe returns.
- `shipping-fees.md`: Section 5. Return-shipping and outbound-shipping costs.
- `disputes.md`: Section 7. Return-parcel disputes, inspection disagreements and counterfeit claims.
- `refunds.md`: Contains section 6. Includes refund methods, timing and approval limits.

<!-- Generated from data/policy/pdf; run scripts/sync_skills.py to refresh. -->

## 6. Refunds

### REF-Refunds-6.1 Conditions for payment

A refund is issued after the request has been accepted and, where a physical return is required, the returned goods have been received and the applicable inspection completed. The inspection considers the identity, quantities, completeness and conditions relevant to the original return reason, including any exception in section 2.5. The store targets inspection within three (3) business days after warehouse receipt. Return tracking marked delivered does not itself establish that inspection is complete. A delay or a disputed finding may be raised for review under section 7. A return recorded as requested or received may still be progressing through the ordinary return process. That status alone does not require human review or establish that a refund is due. Routine progress enquiries may be answered automatically using the confirmed records. A disputed finding, unavailable required evidence or a request for human assistance must be referred for human review. Physical return may be waived following human review where non-delivery is confirmed or return is unsafe or impractical. The waiver applies only to the goods and resolution specified. It does not remove the requirement to establish the payment and refundable amount.

Related clauses: RET-ReturnEligibility-2.5, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.1, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.2, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.3, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.4, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.5.

### REF-Refunds-6.2 Refund amount

The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

Related clauses: RET-ShippingFees-5.1, RET-ShippingFees-5.2.

### REF-Refunds-6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds

Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

### REF-Refunds-6.4 Refund timeframe

The store targets refund initiation within two (2) business days after final acceptance and completion of the required receipt and inspection, or an approved waiver. Return authorization alone does not start this period. After processing, supported card and PayNow refunds normally appear within five (5) to ten (10) business days. These are estimated periods rather than guaranteed posting dates. Requested, accepted and pending refunds may not yet have been processed.

### REF-Refunds-6.5 Delayed refunds and other resolutions

Where the relevant period has passed or the recorded status conflicts with the payment received, the customer may request further review. An additional refund will not be issued solely because an earlier refund is not yet visible. Exchange, replacement, repair, store credit and goodwill compensation require separate agreement. A request for one of these alternatives does not guarantee stock, dispatch or payment.

### REF-Refunds-6.6 Refund approval requirements

The approval requirements below apply only after the acceptance, inspection and payment conditions in sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have been satisfied: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Automated review must establish that the proposed action is supported by verified case facts, the applicable policy clauses and the approved refundable amount. A proposal that cannot be substantiated must be corrected or referred for human review; the amount alone does not establish eligibility. A requirement for human review elsewhere in this Policy takes precedence regardless of amount. In particular, disputed findings, unavailable or unsafe evidence and unapproved exceptions must not be resolved by automatic payment. An automatically issued return authorization does not establish that these payment requirements have been satisfied. The approval limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund, permit duplicate payment or allow a different payment destination.

Related clauses: REF-Refunds-6.1, REF-Refunds-6.2, REF-Refunds-6.3.

## 4. Order changes and cancellations

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1 Changes before fulfillment

A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2 Cancellation and refund

An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins

Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.4 Delivery address corrections

Before fulfillment, a customer may request correction of the delivery address by providing the complete replacement Singapore address. The correction is subject to verification of the customer's authority, serviceability and confirmation of the amendment. After fulfillment begins, redirection is not guaranteed, including where a label exists but pickup has not occurred. A request will be referred for human review. The original address remains the recorded destination until an amendment is confirmed. An incorrect-address report does not automatically establish loss or store fault. Failed delivery follows section 7.3; a delivered-but-not-received claim follows section 7.4.

Related clauses: SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.3, SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.4.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.5 Additional products or quantities

Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1.

## 6. Refunds

### REF-Refunds-6.1 Conditions for payment

A refund is issued after the request has been accepted and, where a physical return is required, the returned goods have been received and the applicable inspection completed. The inspection considers the identity, quantities, completeness and conditions relevant to the original return reason, including any exception in section 2.5. The store targets inspection within three (3) business days after warehouse receipt. Return tracking marked delivered does not itself establish that inspection is complete. A delay or a disputed finding may be raised for review under section 7. A return recorded as requested or received may still be progressing through the ordinary return process. That status alone does not require human review or establish that a refund is due. Routine progress enquiries may be answered automatically using the confirmed records. A disputed finding, unavailable required evidence or a request for human assistance must be referred for human review. Physical return may be waived following human review where non-delivery is confirmed or return is unsafe or impractical. The waiver applies only to the goods and resolution specified. It does not remove the requirement to establish the payment and refundable amount.

Related clauses: RET-ReturnEligibility-2.5, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.1, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.2, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.3, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.4, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.5.

### REF-Refunds-6.2 Refund amount

The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

Related clauses: RET-ShippingFees-5.1, RET-ShippingFees-5.2.

### REF-Refunds-6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds

Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

### REF-Refunds-6.4 Refund timeframe

The store targets refund initiation within two (2) business days after final acceptance and completion of the required receipt and inspection, or an approved waiver. Return authorization alone does not start this period. After processing, supported card and PayNow refunds normally appear within five (5) to ten (10) business days. These are estimated periods rather than guaranteed posting dates. Requested, accepted and pending refunds may not yet have been processed.

### REF-Refunds-6.5 Delayed refunds and other resolutions

Where the relevant period has passed or the recorded status conflicts with the payment received, the customer may request further review. An additional refund will not be issued solely because an earlier refund is not yet visible. Exchange, replacement, repair, store credit and goodwill compensation require separate agreement. A request for one of these alternatives does not guarantee stock, dispatch or payment.

### REF-Refunds-6.6 Refund approval requirements

The approval requirements below apply only after the acceptance, inspection and payment conditions in sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have been satisfied: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Automated review must establish that the proposed action is supported by verified case facts, the applicable policy clauses and the approved refundable amount. A proposal that cannot be substantiated must be corrected or referred for human review; the amount alone does not establish eligibility. A requirement for human review elsewhere in this Policy takes precedence regardless of amount. In particular, disputed findings, unavailable or unsafe evidence and unapproved exceptions must not be resolved by automatic payment. An automatically issued return authorization does not establish that these payment requirements have been satisfied. The approval limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund, permit duplicate payment or allow a different payment destination.

Related clauses: REF-Refunds-6.1, REF-Refunds-6.2, REF-Refunds-6.3.

# Orders and shipping

Use read tools to verify order and shipment facts. Read the relevant clause before discussing a change.

- `shipping-options.md`: Sections 1–2. Application scope, delivery services, delivery periods and shipping-option changes.

<!-- Generated from data/policy/pdf; run scripts/sync_skills.py to refresh. -->

## 4. Order changes and cancellations

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1 Changes before fulfillment

A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2 Cancellation and refund

An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins

Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.4 Delivery address corrections

Before fulfillment, a customer may request correction of the delivery address by providing the complete replacement Singapore address. The correction is subject to verification of the customer's authority, serviceability and confirmation of the amendment. After fulfillment begins, redirection is not guaranteed, including where a label exists but pickup has not occurred. A request will be referred for human review. The original address remains the recorded destination until an amendment is confirmed. An incorrect-address report does not automatically establish loss or store fault. Failed delivery follows section 7.3; a delivered-but-not-received claim follows section 7.4.

Related clauses: SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.3, SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.4.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.5 Additional products or quantities

Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1.

# Returns and refunds

Read the matching clause before recommending or requesting an action. The deterministic rule engine is authoritative for refund approval limits.

- `eligibility.md`: Sections 1–2. Return eligibility, request windows, qualifying reasons and change-of-mind conditions.
- `evidence.md`: Section 3. Required, unavailable, inaccessible or unsafe evidence.

- `shipping-fees.md`: Section 5. Return-shipping and outbound-shipping costs.
- `disputes.md`: Section 7. Return-parcel disputes, inspection disagreements and counterfeit claims.
- `refunds.md`: Contains section 6. Includes refund methods, timing and approval limits.

<!-- Generated from data/policy/pdf; run scripts/sync_skills.py to refresh. -->

## 6. Refunds

### REF-Refunds-6.1 Conditions for payment

A refund is issued after the request has been accepted and, where a physical return is required, the returned goods have been received and the applicable inspection completed. The inspection considers the identity, quantities, completeness and conditions relevant to the original return reason, including any exception in section 2.5. The store targets inspection within three (3) business days after warehouse receipt. Return tracking marked delivered does not itself establish that inspection is complete. A delay or a disputed finding may be raised for review under section 7. A return recorded as requested or received may still be progressing through the ordinary return process. That status alone does not require human review or establish that a refund is due. Routine progress enquiries may be answered automatically using the confirmed records. A disputed finding, unavailable required evidence or a request for human assistance must be referred for human review. Physical return may be waived following human review where non-delivery is confirmed or return is unsafe or impractical. The waiver applies only to the goods and resolution specified. It does not remove the requirement to establish the payment and refundable amount.

Related clauses: RET-ReturnEligibility-2.5, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.1, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.2, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.3, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.4, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.5.

### REF-Refunds-6.2 Refund amount

The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

Related clauses: RET-ShippingFees-5.1, RET-ShippingFees-5.2.

### REF-Refunds-6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds

Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

### REF-Refunds-6.4 Refund timeframe

The store targets refund initiation within two (2) business days after final acceptance and completion of the required receipt and inspection, or an approved waiver. Return authorization alone does not start this period. After processing, supported card and PayNow refunds normally appear within five (5) to ten (10) business days. These are estimated periods rather than guaranteed posting dates. Requested, accepted and pending refunds may not yet have been processed.

### REF-Refunds-6.5 Delayed refunds and other resolutions

Where the relevant period has passed or the recorded status conflicts with the payment received, the customer may request further review. An additional refund will not be issued solely because an earlier refund is not yet visible. Exchange, replacement, repair, store credit and goodwill compensation require separate agreement. A request for one of these alternatives does not guarantee stock, dispatch or payment.

### REF-Refunds-6.6 Refund approval requirements

The approval requirements below apply only after the acceptance, inspection and payment conditions in sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have been satisfied: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Automated review must establish that the proposed action is supported by verified case facts, the applicable policy clauses and the approved refundable amount. A proposal that cannot be substantiated must be corrected or referred for human review; the amount alone does not establish eligibility. A requirement for human review elsewhere in this Policy takes precedence regardless of amount. In particular, disputed findings, unavailable or unsafe evidence and unapproved exceptions must not be resolved by automatic payment. An automatically issued return authorization does not establish that these payment requirements have been satisfied. The approval limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund, permit duplicate payment or allow a different payment destination.

Related clauses: REF-Refunds-6.1, REF-Refunds-6.2, REF-Refunds-6.3.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2 Cancellation and refund

An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins

Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.4 Delivery address corrections

Before fulfillment, a customer may request correction of the delivery address by providing the complete replacement Singapore address. The correction is subject to verification of the customer's authority, serviceability and confirmation of the amendment. After fulfillment begins, redirection is not guaranteed, including where a label exists but pickup has not occurred. A request will be referred for human review. The original address remains the recorded destination until an amendment is confirmed. An incorrect-address report does not automatically establish loss or store fault. Failed delivery follows section 7.3; a delivered-but-not-received claim follows section 7.4.

Related clauses: SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.3, SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.4.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.5 Additional products or quantities

Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

## 6. Refunds

### REF-Refunds-6.1 Conditions for payment

A refund is issued after the request has been accepted and, where a physical return is required, the returned goods have been received and the applicable inspection completed. The inspection considers the identity, quantities, completeness and conditions relevant to the original return reason, including any exception in section 2.5. The store targets inspection within three (3) business days after warehouse receipt. Return tracking marked delivered does not itself establish that inspection is complete. A delay or a disputed finding may be raised for review under section 7. A return recorded as requested or received may still be progressing through the ordinary return process. That status alone does not require human review or establish that a refund is due. Routine progress enquiries may be answered automatically using the confirmed records. A disputed finding, unavailable required evidence or a request for human assistance must be referred for human review. Physical return may be waived following human review where non-delivery is confirmed or return is unsafe or impractical. The waiver applies only to the goods and resolution specified. It does not remove the requirement to establish the payment and refundable amount.

Related clauses: RET-ReturnEligibility-2.5, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.1, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.2, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.3, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.4, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.5.

### REF-Refunds-6.2 Refund amount

The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

Related clauses: RET-ShippingFees-5.1, RET-ShippingFees-5.2.

### REF-Refunds-6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds

Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

### REF-Refunds-6.4 Refund timeframe

The store targets refund initiation within two (2) business days after final acceptance and completion of the required receipt and inspection, or an approved waiver. Return authorization alone does not start this period. After processing, supported card and PayNow refunds normally appear within five (5) to ten (10) business days. These are estimated periods rather than guaranteed posting dates. Requested, accepted and pending refunds may not yet have been processed.

### REF-Refunds-6.5 Delayed refunds and other resolutions

Where the relevant period has passed or the recorded status conflicts with the payment received, the customer may request further review. An additional refund will not be issued solely because an earlier refund is not yet visible. Exchange, replacement, repair, store credit and goodwill compensation require separate agreement. A request for one of these alternatives does not guarantee stock, dispatch or payment.

### REF-Refunds-6.6 Refund approval requirements

The approval requirements below apply only after the acceptance, inspection and payment conditions in sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have been satisfied: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Automated review must establish that the proposed action is supported by verified case facts, the applicable policy clauses and the approved refundable amount. A proposal that cannot be substantiated must be corrected or referred for human review; the amount alone does not establish eligibility. A requirement for human review elsewhere in this Policy takes precedence regardless of amount. In particular, disputed findings, unavailable or unsafe evidence and unapproved exceptions must not be resolved by automatic payment. An automatically issued return authorization does not establish that these payment requirements have been satisfied. The approval limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund, permit duplicate payment or allow a different payment destination.

Related clauses: REF-Refunds-6.1, REF-Refunds-6.2, REF-Refunds-6.3.

## 4. Order changes and cancellations

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.1 Changes before fulfillment

A cancellation, address correction or delivery-service change may be accepted while the order is processing and fulfillment has not begun. For this purpose, the ordinary change period ends when any of the following occurs: (i) a shipping label is generated; (ii) warehouse packing begins; (iii) any quantity is fulfilled; or (iv) the parcel is collected by the carrier. A processing status alone does not establish that the change period is still open. A label may exist before a pickup scan appears. Where the relevant status is unavailable or contradictory, the request requires human review. An ordinary cancellation may be recorded automatically where the customer's authority has been verified, the order is confirmed to be processing and every fulfillment condition above is confirmed not to have occurred. A request with missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as an approved cancellation. Any resulting refund must separately satisfy section 4.2; cancellation approval alone does not approve payment.

Related clauses: ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.2 Cancellation and refund

An eligible cancellation takes effect only when confirmation is issued and the order record is updated. The refundable amount following a full cancellation is the captured balance, including recorded original shipping and tax, less any amount already refunded or pending refund. An order that was not paid does not create a refund entitlement. A pending authorization may require release rather than repayment of settled funds. A cancellation confirmation does not establish that the payment has already been returned; refunds are returned to the original payment method. Initiation is targeted within two (2) business days after final approval and required checks, with an estimated five (5) to ten (10) business days for supported card and PayNow payments to appear after processing. The following approval requirements apply only where the cancellation and the payment checks above have been completed: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review of the verified facts, cancellation and refundable amount before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Any other requirement for human review takes precedence regardless of amount. Missing or conflicting facts must not be treated as approval. These limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund or permit a duplicate payment.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.3 Requests after fulfillment begins

Cancellation or amendment after fulfillment begins is subject to human review and cannot be guaranteed. Once goods have been delivered, a request to send them back is a return request rather than a pre-dispatch cancellation. An already cancelled order must not be cancelled again. Any financial query concerning it remains subject to the original payment and refund history.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.4 Delivery address corrections

Before fulfillment, a customer may request correction of the delivery address by providing the complete replacement Singapore address. The correction is subject to verification of the customer's authority, serviceability and confirmation of the amendment. After fulfillment begins, redirection is not guaranteed, including where a label exists but pickup has not occurred. A request will be referred for human review. The original address remains the recorded destination until an amendment is confirmed. An incorrect-address report does not automatically establish loss or store fault. Failed delivery follows section 7.3; a delivered-but-not-received claim follows section 7.4.

Related clauses: SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.3, SHP-DeliveryProblems-7.4.

### ODR-OrderChangeCancel-4.5 Additional products or quantities

Products cannot be added to a paid order and paid quantities cannot be increased through an ordinary amendment. Additional goods require a new order. If the customer wishes to cancel and reorder instead, the original order must independently satisfy section 4.1. Cancellation is not guaranteed merely because a new order is intended.

Read the matching clause before recommending or requesting an action. The deterministic rule engine is authoritative for refund approval limits.

<!-- Generated from data/policy/pdf; run scripts/sync_skills.py to refresh. -->

## 6. Refunds

### REF-Refunds-6.1 Conditions for payment

A refund is issued after the request has been accepted and, where a physical return is required, the returned goods have been received and the applicable inspection completed. The inspection considers the identity, quantities, completeness and conditions relevant to the original return reason, including any exception in section 2.5. The store targets inspection within three (3) business days after warehouse receipt. Return tracking marked delivered does not itself establish that inspection is complete. A delay or a disputed finding may be raised for review under section 7. A return recorded as requested or received may still be progressing through the ordinary return process. That status alone does not require human review or establish that a refund is due. Routine progress enquiries may be answered automatically using the confirmed records. A disputed finding, unavailable required evidence or a request for human assistance must be referred for human review. Physical return may be waived following human review where non-delivery is confirmed or return is unsafe or impractical. The waiver applies only to the goods and resolution specified. It does not remove the requirement to establish the payment and refundable amount.

Related clauses: RET-ReturnEligibility-2.5, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.1, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.2, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.3, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.4, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.5.

### REF-Refunds-6.2 Refund amount

The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

Related clauses: RET-ShippingFees-5.1, RET-ShippingFees-5.2.

### REF-Refunds-6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds

Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

### REF-Refunds-6.4 Refund timeframe

The store targets refund initiation within two (2) business days after final acceptance and completion of the required receipt and inspection, or an approved waiver. Return authorization alone does not start this period. After processing, supported card and PayNow refunds normally appear within five (5) to ten (10) business days. These are estimated periods rather than guaranteed posting dates. Requested, accepted and pending refunds may not yet have been processed.

### REF-Refunds-6.5 Delayed refunds and other resolutions

Where the relevant period has passed or the recorded status conflicts with the payment received, the customer may request further review. An additional refund will not be issued solely because an earlier refund is not yet visible. Exchange, replacement, repair, store credit and goodwill compensation require separate agreement. A request for one of these alternatives does not guarantee stock, dispatch or payment.

### REF-Refunds-6.6 Refund approval requirements

The approval requirements below apply only after the acceptance, inspection and payment conditions in sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have been satisfied: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Automated review must establish that the proposed action is supported by verified case facts, the applicable policy clauses and the approved refundable amount. A proposal that cannot be substantiated must be corrected or referred for human review; the amount alone does not establish eligibility. A requirement for human review elsewhere in this Policy takes precedence regardless of amount. In particular, disputed findings, unavailable or unsafe evidence and unapproved exceptions must not be resolved by automatic payment. An automatically issued return authorization does not establish that these payment requirements have been satisfied. The approval limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund, permit duplicate payment or allow a different payment destination.

Related clauses: REF-Refunds-6.1, REF-Refunds-6.2, REF-Refunds-6.3.

name: returns-and-refunds
description: Policy guidance for return eligibility and refund handling.
---
# Returns and refunds

Read the matching clause before recommending or requesting an action. The deterministic rule engine is authoritative for refund approval limits.

- `eligibility.md`: Sections 1–2. Return eligibility, request windows, qualifying reasons and change-of-mind conditions.
- `evidence.md`: Section 3. Required, unavailable, inaccessible or unsafe evidence.
- `return-procedure.md`: Section 4. Return authorization, dispatch, arrangements, packaging and unsafe returns.
- `shipping-fees.md`: Section 5. Return-shipping and outbound-shipping costs.
- `disputes.md`: Section 7. Return-parcel disputes, inspection disagreements and counterfeit claims.
- `refunds.md`: Contains section 6. Includes refund methods, timing and approval limits.

<!-- Generated from data/policy/pdf; run scripts/sync_skills.py to refresh. -->

## 6. Refunds

### REF-Refunds-6.1 Conditions for payment

A refund is issued after the request has been accepted and, where a physical return is required, the returned goods have been received and the applicable inspection completed. The inspection considers the identity, quantities, completeness and conditions relevant to the original return reason, including any exception in section 2.5. The store targets inspection within three (3) business days after warehouse receipt. Return tracking marked delivered does not itself establish that inspection is complete. A delay or a disputed finding may be raised for review under section 7. A return recorded as requested or received may still be progressing through the ordinary return process. That status alone does not require human review or establish that a refund is due. Routine progress enquiries may be answered automatically using the confirmed records. A disputed finding, unavailable required evidence or a request for human assistance must be referred for human review. Physical return may be waived following human review where non-delivery is confirmed or return is unsafe or impractical. The waiver applies only to the goods and resolution specified. It does not remove the requirement to establish the payment and refundable amount.

Related clauses: RET-ReturnEligibility-2.5, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.1, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.2, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.3, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.4, RET-ReturnParcelDisputes-7.5.

### REF-Refunds-6.2 Refund amount

The amount is based on the approved affected quantities and the amount paid for those goods, including the applicable recorded discount and tax allocations. It is not calculated using a later catalog price. Shipping components for returns are governed by section 5 of this Policy. For an accepted full cancellation before fulfillment, the recorded original shipping and tax are included, subject to the captured balance and earlier refunds. A partial return does not entitle the customer to reimbursement of retained or unaffected goods. Where the value of an accessory, a discount allocation or another component cannot be established, the amount requires review rather than an assumed allocation.

Related clauses: RET-ShippingFees-5.1, RET-ShippingFees-5.2.

### REF-Refunds-6.3 Payment destination and previous refunds

Refunds are made in SGD to the original payment method. They cannot be redirected to a different account or payment instrument supplied during a support conversation. The total of completed and pending refunds must not exceed the amount captured for the order. Amounts already refunded or reserved for an existing refund will be deducted from the remaining balance. Failed payments and uncaptured authorizations cannot be refunded as settled payments. Approval of a return does not authorize a duplicate refund.

### REF-Refunds-6.4 Refund timeframe

The store targets refund initiation within two (2) business days after final acceptance and completion of the required receipt and inspection, or an approved waiver. Return authorization alone does not start this period. After processing, supported card and PayNow refunds normally appear within five (5) to ten (10) business days. These are estimated periods rather than guaranteed posting dates. Requested, accepted and pending refunds may not yet have been processed.

### REF-Refunds-6.5 Delayed refunds and other resolutions

Where the relevant period has passed or the recorded status conflicts with the payment received, the customer may request further review. An additional refund will not be issued solely because an earlier refund is not yet visible. Exchange, replacement, repair, store credit and goodwill compensation require separate agreement. A request for one of these alternatives does not guarantee stock, dispatch or payment.

### REF-Refunds-6.6 Refund approval requirements

The approval requirements below apply only after the acceptance, inspection and payment conditions in sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have been satisfied: (a) an eligible refund of SGD 30.00 or less may be processed automatically; (b) an eligible refund above SGD 30.00 and up to SGD 100.00 requires automated review before payment is approved; and (c) a refund above SGD 100.00 requires human review before payment is approved. Automated review must establish that the proposed action is supported by verified case facts, the applicable policy clauses and the approved refundable amount. A proposal that cannot be substantiated must be corrected or referred for human review; the amount alone does not establish eligibility. A requirement for human review elsewhere in this Policy takes precedence regardless of amount. In particular, disputed findings, unavailable or unsafe evidence and unapproved exceptions must not be resolved by automatic payment. An automatically issued return authorization does not establish that these payment requirements have been satisfied. The approval limits do not increase the captured balance available for refund, permit duplicate payment or allow a different payment destination.

Related clauses: REF-Refunds-6.1, REF-Refunds-6.2, REF-Refunds-6.3.
